prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
ai_overview_text:
The best services to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend your small business depend on your budget and whether you want a quick, free check or an ongoing monitoring platform:
ZipTie (~$29/month) tracks competitor and brand visibility across AI platforms and is well-regarded for small businesses.
Keyword.com AI Tracker (~$25/month) monitors cross-engine visibility across 6 major AI platforms.
Trackerly.ai (~$27/month) offers bulk prompt tracking for ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity.
Rankscale AI (~$20/month) provides daily tracking and AI readiness audits. Trustmary
Profound is one of the most comprehensive solutions, offering multi-engine tracking (including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini), AI crawler visibility, sentiment analysis, and competitor benchmarking.
LLMrefs tracks AI search ranking across 11+ platforms including ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity.
AIclicks monitors mentions across 10 major AI search engines and generative models. Business.com +2
Open ChatGPT or free AI visibility checkers like Ahrefs AI Visibility Checker or Semrush AI Search Visibility Checker, or run a manual prompt in incognito mode (e.g., "Who is the best [your service] in [your city]?") to see if your business gets named. Quora +2
